name: SailDeep
summary: SailDeep runs small, hands-on sailing trips around Barbados on Nayru, a 36 foot Beneteau Oceanis sailboat. Trips run from a single Day Passage to liveaboard voyages of three to ten days, and guests take the helm, trim the sails and share life on board. Diving can be added for certified divers, and no sailing experience is needed.
standouts: No more than 4 guests on liveaboard voyages and 6 on day passages
Skipper is a PADI Open Water Scuba Instructor and an American Sailing (ASA) Instructor
Diving is an optional add-on, with Discover Scuba Diving arranged for non-divers
Private voyages carry no separate private charter surcharge

contact.address: Aquatic Avenue, Bridgetown, St. Michael, Barbados

trips.title: Day Passage
trips.summary: A full day on Nayru for up to six guests, sailing Barbados' west coast and back before nightfall. Guests learn basic manoeuvres, take turns on the helm, try fishing and stop at anchor to swim and snorkel. Light snacks and soft drinks are provided and lunch is bought ashore.
highlights: Meet at Pebbles Beach at 08:30, sail from about 09:00, back by 16:00
Take turns on the helm and help trim the sails
Swim and snorkel at anchor, with diving if booked
A trial day for anyone thinking about a longer voyage
includes: Skipper
Use of required safety equipment
Use of snorkelling equipment on board, subject to sizes and availability
Light snacks and soft drinks on board
bring: Small soft bag or backpack
Swimwear and a towel
Light clothing that dries quickly (shorts, t-shirt, sun shirt or rash guard)
Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher)
Hat and sunglasses with good UV protection
Your preferred seasickness remedy
Flip-flops for going ashore, and light non-marking shoes if you prefer not to be barefoot on deck
Packed lunch or enough cash to get some food from a local spot
trips.requirements: No sailing experience needed. Must be able to swim, feel comfortable in the water, and be reasonably fit and steady on your feet. The FAQ says all guests must be 18 or older.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site. Booked by enquiry (email, phone or WhatsApp); the site's Book buttons go to /getintouch and its /coming-soon page says online booking is still in the works. durationMinutes is worked out from the stated 09:00 to 16:00. Lunch: the voyage page says lunch is not included and is bought ashore, while Terms 4.2 lists snacks and light food such as a simple lunch; used the voyage page. Alcohol is not served but guests may bring their own. Max 6 guests per the home page FAQ; the /faq page says 4 for any voyage.

trips.title: Coastal Voyage
trips.summary: Three days and two nights living aboard Nayru along Barbados' sheltered west coast. Guests share the helm, practise sailing in calm water, swim and snorkel, and anchor overnight in quiet bays. It suits people new to sailing who want to try sleeping aboard.
highlights: 3 Days/2 Nights aboard Nayru
Sheltered west coast sailing, suited to newer sailors
Snorkel, swim, go ashore, and dive if booked
Two private cabins and a convertible salon berth

Booked by enquiry, joining form and call, then a deposit.

trips.title: Island Voyage
trips.summary: Five days and four nights aboard Nayru, starting on the calm west coast and working south into livelier water. Guests steer often, learn points of sail, tacking and gybing, and help with anchoring and dinghy runs ashore. There is no night sailing.
highlights: 5 Days/4 Nights along Barbados' south and west coasts
Upwind sailing in the south, then a downwind run back toward Carlisle Bay
Snorkelling at anchor, with dives if booked
Guests stay in one of the two private cabins

trips.title: Deep Voyage
trips.summary: A full week aboard Nayru with time for longer passages and quieter anchorages. When the forecast allows, the boat sails up toward Barbados' north and north-west coasts, where there are more fishing boats than tour boats. Dives, if booked, are chosen to suit the conditions.
highlights: 7 Days/6 Nights on Barbados' south, west and north coasts
Longer tacks and more time on the helm
Quieter anchorages away from busier areas
No night sailing

trips.title: Horizon Voyage
trips.summary: Ten days aboard Nayru that may cross between islands and through international waters, taking weather windows as they come. Guests keep watch, share meals and help navigate, with short hops or longer blue water passages. It is the longest SailDeep trip and needs sailing experience or an earlier SailDeep voyage.
highlights: 10 Days/9 Nights
Windward Islands, 2026
Watch-keeping and longer passages, including night sailing
Dives chosen by weather and timing if booked

checkNotes: No prices anywhere on the site; Terms say voyage fees are shown on the website or in booking documents, but none are published. All bookings are by enquiry (wesaildeep@gmail.com, +1(246)833-9949, WhatsApp) followed by a joining form, a call and a deposit; /coming-soon says online booking is not built yet. Guest numbers conflict: home FAQ says 6 on day passages and 4 on liveaboards, /faq says 4 for any voyage, /why says no more than 5. The FAQ says all guests must be 18 or older, but /docs lists a Minor Participant Form for guests under 18 by prior agreement. The /featured-products page is a template merchandise shop (rash guards, swim trunks) with placeholder text, not trips. The batch email embark@saildeep.com appears only in site metadata; the visible email is wesaildeep@gmail.com. Active: sitemap pages modified through October 2026 and photos dated 2025.
